desc: Parse input N, M and the list of colored cells.
Compute $R_r^{min}$ for each row $r$ from $1$ to $N$. Since $N$ is large, use a dictionary or hash map for rows/cols that have black cells. Rows with no black cells have $R_r=0$.
Compute $C_c^{min}$ for each column $c$ from $1$ to $N$. Similarly, use a dictionary. Columns with no black cells have $C_c=0$.

Iterate through all given Black cells and verify $c \le R_r$ and $r \le C_c$. (This is theoretically guaranteed by construction, but we can skip explicit check if we trust the logic, or include it for safety).
Iterate through all given White cells and verify $c > R_r$ OR $r > C_c$. If any fail, print "No" and exit.
If all white cells pass, print "Yes".
